content.title: 2026 NCAA Final Four, Tickets, Packages, Travel, Trips, Hospitality
content.text: 2026 Final Four Travel PackagesAbout the 2026 Final FourWhere is the 2026 Final Four being played? At Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.This modern stadium opened in 2008. The seating capacity for Lucas Oil Stadium is upwards of 70,000 for basketball events. The Lucas Oil Stadium features some of the latest innovations in stadium technology.How can you attend the Final Four? The 2026 Final Four will take place from April 4th through April 6th. The best way to get tickets is with an all inclusive travel package with lodging in downtown Indianapolis for the entire tournament. Your package also has a full-strip of tickets for both Semi-Final Games on Saturday and tickets to the National Championship Game on Monday night. With lodging within walking distance to Lucas oil Stadium, your weekend will be easy and enjoyable.What's a full-strip Final Four Ticket?When you purchase tickets to the Final Four, you will receive a small booklet that contains tickets to Saturday's semi-final games plus Monday's Championship game. Saturday will feature both Semi Final Games, played back-to-back with a small intermission in between. Tickets for Saturday are for the entire day and cannot be broken apart. Monday's Championship game is played in the evening. Future Final Four Dates:The NCAA has already selected future dates for The Final Four! -2027 - Detroit, MI - Ford Field-2028 - Las Vegas, NV - Allegiant Stadium-2029 - Indianapolis, IN - Lucas Oil Stadium
